If you can get to a window or another exit without risking a fight, do that. Keep your phone with you, and don't argue or try to force her to unlock it.

If you're in the US and can't call 911 safely, text 911 or call 988 for support while you wait for help.

- **Get near another person.** If you can, go to someone you trust, or ask them to stay with you.
